reason: I already fall asleep to free YouTube ASMR with a 30-minute timer every night and it works well enough. I might try the free 14 days out of curiosity since it doesn't auto-charge, but I'm not paying for an app to do what YouTube does for free.
objection: YouTube sleep music is free and has way more sounds than 2 basic ones. A fade that's a bit smarter than my timer doesn't feel like a real difference, and I doubt a phone on the bed can tell exactly when I fell asleep.
would_change_my_mind: If the 14-day comparison actually showed me falling asleep 10+ minutes faster with my own data, I'd consider the yearly plan, but only if it were closer to 1,000-2,000 won a month.
